draft.title: HUMAN RESOURCES
draft.position_summary: Creates, develops and manages public ceremonial, social and special events hosted by the Chancellor, President and/or other SFU officials. Has full responsibility and accountability for high- profile events that provide important forums for interactions with leading campus donors, alumni, elected officials, volunteers and business leaders; campus protocol, social etiquette and a spirit of goodwill that fosters the best possible institutional image. Provide advice and guidance to university units on event planning.

duties.statement: % of time Conceptualizes, directs, administers, and evaluates University ceremonies and 70% special events: ten (presently) annual Convocation ceremonies, SFU/SCES Convocation in Kamloops, other off-site Convocation ceremonies as required, two President’s and Chancellor's Dinners, Awards Ceremony, President and Chancellor Installation ceremonies, two Honour Roll Receptions, various building/room openings, and other events hosted by the Chancellor, President and/or other SFU officials. Develops policies and procedures for detailed planning of ceremonial and special events. Directs special SFU "friend" and "fund" raising events administered by the Associate Director (eg Presidential dinners in various locations, President's Club luncheons and dinners, President's Research Luncheon, alumni events and donor recognition events). Supervises database record keeping related to official university guest lists and replies to functions. Establishes and directs the registration process for all special events, through the use of complex database files for specialized reports to the President, appropriate Vice-Presidents, Registrar and Dean of Student Services, Media and Public Relations personnel, and marshals of processions. Supervises development of computer applications, forms and procedures for records and statistics. Position Number 31160 (Continued)

model.title: Ceremonial and Special Events Coordinator
model.position_summary: Provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for university ceremonies, convocation, installations, award presentations and high‑profile fundraising events. The role develops policies, directs planning and ensures seamless execution of events that showcase the institution to donors, alumni, officials and community partners. By advising academic and administrative units, managing budgets, coordinating logistics and supervising staff, the coordinator safeguards institutional protocol and enhances SFU’s public image.

duties.statement: University ceremonies and special events, including convocation, installations and fundraising functions, by developing policies, procedures and annual plans
how_why: Conceptualizes, directs, administers, and evaluates university ceremonies and special events, including annual convocation ceremonies, president and chancellor dinners, awards ceremonies, installations, honour roll receptions, building openings, and other events hosted by senior officials.
Develops policies and procedures for detailed planning of ceremonial and special events.
Directs special fundraising events administered by the Associate Director, such as presidential dinners, President’s Club luncheons, research luncheons, alumni events, and donor recognition events.
Involved in annual planning and recommending budget allocations for events.

duties.statement: Venue preparation, logistics and support services for on‑site and off‑site events, ensuring all requirements for dignitaries and external productions are met
how_why: Arranges venue preparation and negotiates facility arrangements on and off campus.
Identifies and coordinates support services from Dining Services, Diamond University Centre, Facilities Management, Campus Security, and other areas as needed.
Acts as university liaison with the Simon Fraser University Pipe Band, coordinating arrangements for pipe band events and representing the university at the World Pipe Band Championships.

duties.statement: Guest invitation, registration, seating and correspondence processes to ensure accurate and professional communication with participants
how_why: Plans and supervises staff in generating invitation lists, designing invitations and programs, printing, mailing, and managing RSVP activities.
Supervises database record keeping for official guest lists and function replies.
Establishes and directs the registration process for all special events using complex database files for specialized reports to senior officials and media.
Directs guest and seating arrangements for convocation, awards ceremonies, special dinners, and other events.
Composes correspondence for the President’s and Chancellor’s signature, including special invitations to honorary degree recipients, government and business leaders, and award recipients.
Plans and coordinates arrangements for visiting honorary degree recipients, including reports, statistical information, and special dinner arrangements.

duties.statement: Event and departmental budgets, financial controls and procurement to support cost‑effective delivery of ceremonies and special functions
how_why: Develops and administers the departmental budget, including general, non‑recurring, and event‑specific funds.
Monitors and approves budget expenses and commitments against allocations.
Develops, monitors and administers event budgets on a cost‑recovery basis.
Requisitions goods and services and monitors commitments against allocations.
Recommends capital purchases to the Vice‑President, University Relations.
Supervises caterers and related service providers.

duties.statement: University committees, protocol guidance and stakeholder liaison to uphold institutional traditions and resolve complex issues
how_why: Acts as consultant on protocol, university tradition, invitation and program design/printing, and preparation for similar events arranged by other campus units.
Authorizes nominations for student piping awards.

Liaises with administrative units such as the Registrar’s Office, Dean of Student Services, Dean of Graduate Studies, and directors of student resources regarding event participation and student advising.
